name: inamap-frontend-domain
description: INAMAP — frontend del dominio (apps inamap-web, inamap-system, inamap-app y paquetes ina-*) sobre el framework DashAdmin

scripts._INFO: Apps: inamap-web (tenants), inamap-system (plataforma), inamap-app (visor público). Entorno por app: apps/<app>/.env.<app>.<entorno> (DashAdmin) o apps/inamap-app/.env.local.
scripts.dev:web: cross-env CUSTOM_MODE=inamap-web.local TARGET_TYPE=web PLATFORM=web pnpm --filter inamap-web dev
scripts.dev:system: cross-env CUSTOM_MODE=inamap-system.local TARGET_TYPE=web PLATFORM=web pnpm --filter inamap-system dev
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n app,web,system -c green,magenta,blue "pnpm dev:app" "pnpm dev:web" "pnpm dev:system"
scripts._TUNNEL: Frontends públicos (app-dev/web-dev/system-dev.inamap.space) sobre el túnel inamap-dev del backend. Una vez: pnpm tunnel:init && pnpm tunnel:routes. Luego pnpm dev:tunnel:all (o dev:web:tunnel, etc.). Requiere el backend con ./inamap.sh up --tunnel.
scripts.dev:web:tunnel: cross-env CUSTOM_MODE=inamap-web.tunnel TARGET_TYPE=web PLATFORM=web pnpm --filter inamap-web dev
scripts.dev:system:tunnel: cross-env CUSTOM_MODE=inamap-system.tunnel TARGET_TYPE=web PLATFORM=web pnpm --filter inamap-system dev
scripts.dev:tunnel:all: pnpm tunnel:routes && concurrently -n app,web,system -c green,magenta,blue "pnpm dev:app:tunnel" "pnpm dev:web:tunnel" "pnpm dev:system:tunnel"
scripts.build:web: cross-env CUSTOM_MODE=inamap-web.${INAMAP_ENV:-local} TARGET_TYPE=web PLATFORM=web pnpm --filter inamap-web build
scripts.build:system: cross-env CUSTOM_MODE=inamap-system.${INAMAP_ENV:-local} TARGET_TYPE=web PLATFORM=web pnpm --filter inamap-system build
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm build:web && pnpm build:system && pnpm build:app
